normalization_applied.ordering: Rows matched by declared/candidate key (order_id,line_number), not fetch order.
normalization_applied.nulls: NULL normalized to a fixed sentinel distinct from any real value before hashing.
normalization_applied.floats: Numeric-typed or numeric-looking columns rounded to 4 decimal places before hashing.
normalization_applied.timezones: Columns whose values parse as timestamps normalized to UTC ISO-8601 before hashing.

diagnosis.explanation: Order 5230/line 1 exists in silver.orders but is absent from gold.legacy_fct_orders. Cross-referencing silver.orders shows this row's customer_id (99999) has no matching row in silver.customers -- the gold table's own documented build note says it is produced via an INNER JOIN to customers, so a row with an unresolvable customer_id would be silently dropped rather than carried through with a null/unknown customer attribution.
diagnosis.basis: 0.5-0.74: cross-referenced the missing key directly against source data (confirmed orphaned customer_id) and against gold.legacy_fct_orders's own table comment describing an inner-join build, but the actual pipeline/query that built gold.legacy_fct_orders was not inspected directly.
diagnosis.suggested_fix: Decide, with the business, whether orders with an unresolvable customer_id should be included (via a LEFT JOIN, attributed to an 'unknown customer' surrogate) or genuinely excluded from fct_orders by design; if included, rebuild the gold table's join logic accordingly. This skill does not apply this fix.
